ارتشفت (form VIII)
# اِرْتَشَفْتُ (irtašaftu) /ir.ta.ʃaf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# اِرْتَشَفْتَ (irtašafta) /ir.ta.ʃaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# اِرْتَشَفْتِ (irtašafti) /ir.ta.ʃaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# اِرْتَشَفَتْ (irtašafat) /ir.ta.ʃa.fat/: third-perso
